---
title: 'Laser treatment and time to vision loss'
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Step 4 of 4. Render from this directory with
# Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("report.Rmd")'
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
model <- readRDS('model.rds')
figures <- readRDS('figures.rds')
ci <- summary(model)$conf.int
```

The data are the `diabetic` retinopathy trial shipped with the
`survival` package: `r nrow(survival::diabetic)` eyes of
`r length(unique(survival::diabetic$id))` patients, one eye of each
patient treated by laser.

Laser treatment is associated with a hazard ratio for vision loss of
`r sprintf('%.2f', ci['armLaser', 'exp(coef)'])` (95% CI
`r sprintf('%.2f', ci['armLaser', 'lower .95'])` to
`r sprintf('%.2f', ci['armLaser', 'upper .95'])`, robust standard
errors clustered on patient), adjusting for age at diagnosis.

```{r km, echo = FALSE}
figures
```
